861:t_142:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll raise this unit's Mobility, and have that pilot learn a special skill that boosts Morale...」

861:t_142:4.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Man, so fiddly. If you're a real man, dump the whole budget into weapon upgrades!」

861:t_142:5.en:
$$レド$$
「However, Chamber recommends a well-balanced custom build.」

861:t_142:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Just ignore that tin-can's hard-headed way of doing things!」

861:t_142:7.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But, $$ピニオン$$... You're always the one getting wiped out, aren't you?」

861:t_142:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I-it's fine! I'm a repairman, after all!」

861:t_142:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Players, you can upgrade and train however you like, but don't turn out like $$ピニオン$$.」

861:t_143:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll raise this unit's Mobility, and have that pilot learn a special skill that boosts Morale...」

861:t_143:4.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Man, so fiddly. If you're a real man, dump the whole budget into weapon upgrades!」

861:t_143:5.en:
$$レド$$
「However, Chamber recommends a well-balanced custom build.」

861:t_143:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Just ignore that tin-can's hard-headed way of doing things!」

861:t_143:7.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But, $$ピニオン$$... You're always the one getting wiped out, aren't you?」

861:t_143:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I-it's fine! I'm a repairman, after all!」

861:t_143:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Players, you can upgrade and train however you like, but don't turn out like $$ピニオン$$.」

861:t_144:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good work, everyone. Please get a good rest.」

861:t_144:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And where might you be going? Remedial lessons are waiting for you after this.」

861:t_144:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Once you've refreshed yourselves with the game, everyone, please work hard at your studies and jobs, too.」

861:t_144:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well then, until we meet again!」

861:t_145:4.en:
$n
「Sorry. I let you see something unsightly.」

861:t_145:5.en:
$n
「As you saw, even now I'm fighting fear deep inside.」

861:t_145:6.en:
$n
「But the greatest fear is that, with the game left on hold like this, my volunteer spirit will rust.」

861:t_145:7.en:
$n
「So I'm waiting for you to come back. Let's go pick up trash together again.」

861:t_146:3.en:
$n
「Good work, players, everyone. I'm stepping away from the game too, to fully enjoy my hobby time.」

861:t_146:4.en:
$n
「If you like, why don't you all join in? Picking up trash under the sun is the best.」

861:t_146:5.en:
$n
「...Joking aside, after a long game session I recommend getting some exercise.」

861:t_146:6.en:
$n
「Well, I'm off to pick up trash. See you again.」

861:t_147:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good work. What are you planning to do now?」

861:t_147:4.en:
$n
「I was thinking of going to pick up trash...」

861:t_147:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Very good. Then as your advisor, I'll join you.」

861:t_147:6.en:
$n
「Then I'll go call the others, too.」

861:t_147:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Stop! ...Today I'd like it to be just the two of us...」

861:t_147:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's how it is, players, please close your eyes for a little while.」

861:t_147:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well then, until we meet again.」

861:t_148:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What... is that it already? Pathetic.」

861:t_148:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Show me some drive. Enough drive to clear this game with no resets and no stopping.」

861:t_148:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... I'm expecting great things from you. So hurry back.」

861:t_148:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When you do, I'll play with y-o-u.」

861:t_149:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If they're pausing, this is a good chance. Let's have the player decide which of us to choose, me or you.」

861:t_149:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you choose me, I'll give you plenty of the kind of service a stiff schoolteacher can't offer.」

861:t_149:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then you'd better think up some service you can offer, too.」

861:t_149:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's how it is. Decide which of us you're choosing before you resume the game.」

861:t_150:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Good work, players, everyone. Please get a good rest.」

861:t_150:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm a little tired too, so I think I'll have something sweet and take a break.」

861:t_150:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Did you know? Chocolate goes great with beer.」

861:t_150:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll be careful not to drink so much that something sad happens. Well then, everyone... until we meet again.」

861:t_151:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Come to think of it, we've come a long way.」

861:t_151:4.en:
$$メール$$
「But the $$ビーター・サービス$$ journey is almost over, too...」

861:t_151:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Gloom doesn't suit us, $$メール$$!」

861:t_151:6.en:
$$メール$$
「OK, Darling! Let's keep smiling and do our best to the very end!」

861:t_151:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「So that's how it is, players! Lend us your strength to the very last!」

861:t_151:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's keep it hot! Extra hot!」

861:t_152:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「Who'd have thought we'd end up appearing here together like this.」

861:t_152:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No kidding. We've got to be thankful that the 'Super Robot Wars Z' series kept going.」

861:t_152:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Everything has an end... Is what I'd like to say, but your debt is the one thing that's eternal.」

861:t_152:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you players, too. Clear the game quick so $$クロウ$$ can focus on paying off his debt.」

861:t_152:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「See you. I'll be looking forward to it.」

861:t_153:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「The day has finally come when we can greet you players here.」

861:t_153:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A whole year of hardship since 'Jigoku-hen'...! I've been waiting for this day!」

861:t_153:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「If we're counting that way, I waited four years since 'Hakai-hen'.」

861:t_153:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's pour all of those feelings into this!」

861:t_153:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you, everyone. Master the 'D-Command' and seize victory.」

861:t_153:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's give it our all today too...!」

861:t_153:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh! Full voice is the best, isn't it!」

861:t_154:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now then, since the game has come to a pause, let's discuss his future training plan.」

861:t_154:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「First, a smile! Go on, stop being the quiet type!」

861:t_154:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Next, charm! Hang in there, stop being the quiet type!」
